RC-001.note: Native Screenshot transport resolves and subscribes the unique owner before requesting pixels, uses native consent without an automatic retry, verifies the returned request handle and produces no overlay on denial/cancellation/failure. Private-bus tests exercise actual production transport and controller, missing/disconnected services, cold-start/legacy response ordering, owner/sender/path fencing and invalid input. Complete native backend/permission/compositor qualification and human security review remain Required.

RC-002.note: The portal owns native consent; explicit NotAllowed/AccessDenied errors return capture-permission-denied once. Response code 1 is user cancellation, not an inferred denial. Private-bus production tests prove no overlay, clipboard or save on denial and value-free diagnostics. Historical single-display Hyprland smoke evidence is not full qualification. Permission-settings navigation where available, physical consent and human capture-permission/security review remain Required.

RC-003.note: Selection and confirming composition cancel on native screen add/remove, geometry, orientation and DPI signals. Core topology vectors pass. Native uniform-scale inference still lacks authoritative stable identity, per-display physical mapping, rotation and colour descriptions; see app/SOURCE-TOPOLOGY-REVIEW.md. Complete native topology qualification remains Required.

RC-004.note: Qt Core mapping passes every published per-monitor vector. The current native frozen-source controller still assumes uniform desktop scale; a qualified per-monitor physical source backend remains Required. Core vector success does not prove mixed-scale native capture.

RC-005.note: One frameless fullscreen overlay per screen shows the frozen snapshot. Verified on a single Hyprland display; multi-display layouts are unverified.

RC-008.note: Core cancellation is terminal and side-effect free. Native Cancel Capture closes pending portal requests; overlay Escape and Cancel Capture also cancel confirming composition without capture publication, file or clipboard changes. A worker owns frozen inputs and cooperative cancellation; the GUI never joins it. Private-bus production tests pause the actual compositor before start, midway and at the final row, prove responsive Escape, unchanged fixtures, non-blocking destruction and late-worker isolation. Cancellation/progress during encoding and subsequent pipeline work, and physical consent/overlay qualification remain Required.

RC-010.note: Arrow, Shift+Arrow, and Alt+Arrow steps are clamped and the precision modifier is shown in the overlay hint bar. Resize handles and size presets are not yet interactive.

RC-011.note: Click-to-snap and drag override are implemented (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/RegionCaptureTest.cpp). Native window and control discovery arrives with the overlay. The overlay badge shows physical size and origin with tabular digits on Qt 6.7+ and the native fixed font on Qt 6.4; the Ubuntu CI job checks the minimum-version app build.

RC-012.note: The same Qt Core compositor serves conformance and native worker composition: exact source pixels, transparent gaps, bounded output, no resampling, cooperative cancellation and discarded partial output. SnapshotCompositionTest independently checks native pixel placement, image ownership and retained colour metadata. The frozen-source controller still assumes uniform desktop scale; authoritative per-monitor acquisition and complete mixed-scale/native qualification remain Required.

RC-014.note: Frozen mode from one portal snapshot is implemented. Live mode is not offered.

RC-016.note: Core terminal-event vectors pass. Native Screenshot and confirming composition publish one terminal result; duplicate starts/responses/selection inputs, late cancelled workers and controller replacement/destruction have production tests. A successful private fixture runs one save/clipboard pipeline. General pipeline cancellation/terminal coverage and full physical native qualification remain Required.

RC-017.note: The last region is produced only on capture success and validated against topology (platforms/linux/linux-qt/tests/RegionCaptureTest.cpp). Atomic persistence arrives with settings storage.

RC-018.note: Native failures expose stable capture-source-failed or capture-permission-denied without raw portal errors/URIs. Shared decode and composition resource bounds reject excess output before unsafe arithmetic. Worker cancellation discards pixels and source-result metadata; source/progress exceptions return value-free diagnostics. Borrowed files remain unmodified and no owned screenshot cache precedes confirmation. Core/native/private-bus tests cover corrupt/oversized input, exact pixels, cancellation and unchanged files. Complete capture retention/diagnostic policy, portal-owned revocation and human security/privacy review remain Required.

RC-019.note: Native keyboard selection, accessible bounds/instructions and actual progress in overlay descriptions and a command-window QProgressBar have fixture evidence. Cancelled progress returns to a terminal command-window status without an alert; successful/error results remain visible. Full physical keyboard/compositor and Orca qualification remain Required.

RC-020.note: A worker removes source copying/format preparation/composition from the GUI; private-bus tests prove event-loop responsiveness and non-blocking cancellation/destruction. Required physical overlay frame-rate, acquisition/composition latency and resource measurements on the supported native matrix have not been established.

RC-022.note: Qt Core mapping follows the specified binary64/floor arithmetic and reporting-display rules, with all published vectors passing. Actual native per-monitor source/topology integration remains Required because the current controller assumes uniform scale.

RC-024.note: Keyboard steps are announced to assistive technology through the overlay's accessible description.
